wordmark.purpose: The Nebulosa name beside the logo in the top bar, hidden on phones.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action of a group: Solve Image, Start, Save.

components.name: Secondary Button

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: An icon-only command or toggle; its label is the tooltip.
components.css: .ds-icon-row { display: inline-flex; gap: 7px; } .ds-icon-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink-200); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { background: var(--color-base-300); color: var(--color-ink-100); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-icon-btn--pressed, .ds-icon-btn--pressed:hover { background: var(--color-accent-subtle); color: var(--color-accent); }

components.name: Number Field
components.description: A labelled field with its unit inside the right edge.
components.css: .ds-field { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3.5px; width: 220px; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 10.5px; line-height: 14px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-ink-200); } .ds-field-box { position: relative; } .ds-input { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; height: 33.25px; padding: 7px 28px 7px 10.5px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line-200); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-base-200); color: var(--color-ink-100); font-size: 12.25px; line-height: 17.5px; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--color-ink-300); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-accent); outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-field-unit { position: absolute; top: 50%; right: 10.5px; transform: translateY(-50%); font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--color-ink-300); pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Two to five short options, the chosen one in Ember Wash.
components.css: .ds-seg { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); display: flex; height: 33.25px; } .ds-seg-opt { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); flex: 1; padding: 0 7px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line-200); background: var(--color-base-200); color: var(--color-ink-200); font-size: 12.25px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-seg-opt + .ds-seg-opt { margin-left: -1px; } .ds-seg-opt:first-child { border-radius: 6px 0 0 6px; } .ds-seg-opt:last-child { border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0; } .ds-seg-opt:hover { background: var(--color-base-300); color: var(--color-ink-100); } .ds-seg-opt:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; position: relative; z-index: 2; } .ds-seg-opt--on, .ds-seg-opt--on:hover { position: relative; z-index: 1; border-color: var(--color-accent); background: var(--color-accent-subtle); color: var(--color-accent); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A state in words, tinted by its tone.
components.html: ExposingConnectedFlip soonFailedIdle
components.css: .ds-badges { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 7px; } .ds-badge { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5.25px; height: 21px; padding: 0 8.75px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line-100); border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 10.5px; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--color-ink-200); } .ds-badge i { width: 5.25px; height: 5.25px; border-radius: 9999px; background: currentColor; } .ds-badge--active { color: var(--color-accent); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 50%, transparent); } .ds-badge--active i { animation: ds-pulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite; } .ds-badge--success { color: var(--color-success); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-success) 50%, transparent); } .ds-badge--warning { color: var(--color-warning); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-warning) 60%, transparent); } .ds-badge--danger { color: var(--color-danger); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-danger) 60%, transparent); } .ds-badge--muted { color: var(--color-ink-300); border-style: dashed; } .ds-badge--muted i { display: none; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 50% { opacity: 0.5; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-badge--active i { animation: none; } }

components.name: Tool Card
components.description: An entry of the Tools catalog: icon tile, name, availability, description.
components.css: .ds-tool-card { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10.5px; width: 300px; padding: 10.5px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line-100); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--color-base-000); color: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-tool-card:hover { border-color: var(--color-line-200); } .ds-tool-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tool-icon { display: flex; flex: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 31.5px; height: 31.5px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-base-200); color: var(--color-ink-200); } .ds-tool-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3.5px; min-width: 0; } .ds-tool-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 7px; } .ds-tool-name { font-size: 12.25px; line-height: 17.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-ink-100); } .ds-tool-pill { flex: none; padding: 1px 7px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-success) 40%, transparent); border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 10.5px; line-height: 14px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-success); } .ds-tool-desc { font-size: 10.5px; line-height: 14px; color: var(--color-ink-200); }

components.name: Navigation Rail
components.description: The workspace switcher; the active entry carries the Ember Clay bar.
components.css: .ds-rail { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 3.5px; width: 56px; padding: 7px 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--color-line-100); background: var(--color-base-000); } .ds-rail-btn { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 3.5px; width: 49px; padding: 7px 0; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink-300); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-rail-btn span { font-size: 10.5px; line-height: 10.5px; } .ds-rail-btn:hover { background: var(--color-base-300); color: var(--color-ink-100); } .ds-rail-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-rail-btn--on, .ds-rail-btn--on:hover { background: var(--color-accent-subtle); color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-rail-btn--on span { font-weight: 600; } .ds-rail-btn b { position: absolute; top: 7px; bottom: 7px; left: -3.5px; width: 3.5px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-accent); }

components.css: .ds-panel { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); width: 280px; background: var(--color-base-000); border: 1px solid var(--color-line-100); } .ds-sec { padding: 10.5px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line-100); } .ds-sec:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-sec summary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; list-style: none; cursor: pointer; font-size: 10.5px; line-height: 14px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-ink-300); } .ds-sec summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-sec summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); } .ds-sec summary svg { flex: none; transition: transform 150ms; } .ds-sec[open] > summary svg { transform: rotate(90deg); } .ds-sec summary em { margin-left: auto; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; color: var(--color-ink-200); } .ds-sec[open] summary em { display: none; } .ds-rows { margin-top: 7px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; column-gap: 10.5px; font-size: 12.25px; line-height: 17.5px; } .ds-row span { color: var(--color-ink-300); } .ds-row b { margin-left: auto; font-weight: 400; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--color-ink-100); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-sec summary svg { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Nebulosa looks like the control desk of a small observatory at night: a dense, calm surface of warm near-black panels, monospace readouts, and one ember glow that marks what is live or chosen. It is built for an operator in the dark, often across the room or on a phone, so the interface never competes with the sky. Chrome stays quiet; readings, status words, and the image or star map in the middle carry the screen.

Density is high and deliberate. The root type size is 14 px, dense panels run at 12.25 px and 10.5 px, and the frame (top bar, navigation rail, status bar, contextual panel) is fixed so the eye always knows where status, navigation, and controls live. Depth comes from small tonal steps between warm darks and from one-pixel lines, not from shadows, gradients, or glow.

The system rejects four looks outright: the neon sci-fi HUD (glowing cyan or purple, scanlines, space-game chrome), any light or bright theme, glossy consumer SaaS (gradients, big shadowed rounded cards, marketing flourishes inside the app), and the default cool blue-gray dark palette.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only, warm neutrals, one ember accent.
One typeface for everything: JetBrains Mono, tabular figures for values.
Flat, tonally layered surfaces divided by one-pixel lines.
Small uppercase tracked labels head every group.
Status is always written in words; colour only reinforces it.
A fixed console frame around one swappable workspace.

rules.name: The One Ember Rule
rules.body: Ember Clay marks what is chosen, focused, running, or the one primary action. It is never decoration, never a background block, never a second brand colour. If two things on a screen glow, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Warm Dark Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is warm. A new colour enters as a token in `web/src/index.css`, never as a literal in a component, and never as a cool blue-gray.

rules.name: The Words First Rule
rules.body: A signal colour never carries a state alone: the state is a word (Connected, Slewing, Failed) and the colour only tints it.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is the only typeface. Hierarchy comes from size, weight, case, and the three ink tones, never from a second family.

rules.name: The Aligned Digits Rule
rules.body: Every value that can change or be compared (coordinates, temperatures, counts, times, table numbers) uses tabular figures and is right-aligned against its label.

rules.name: The Fixed Frame Rule
rules.body: Status lives in the status bar, navigation in the rail, context in the right panel. A new screen fills the workspace slot and never invents a second frame, toolbar zone, or status surface.

rules.name: The Flat Desk Rule
rules.body: Anything that sits in the layout is flat. A shadow means "this is floating above the desk and will go away"; cards, panels, and sections never get one.

dos: Do use the colour tokens (`base-000`…`base-300`, `line-100`/`line-200`, `ink-100`…`ink-300`, `accent`, the four signals) and add a new token in `web/src/index.css` before using a new colour.
Do keep Ember Clay to selection, focus, running state, and one primary action per group.
Do write every state as a word and every quantity with its unit, with colour only reinforcing it.
Do show every datum as a data row: muted label left, tabular value right.
Do head every group with the uppercase 10.5 px Label (0.08em tracking).
Do use 6 px corners on controls, 10 px on buttons and cards, 24 px only on modals.
Do keep transitions at 150 ms on colour and honour `motion-reduce`.
Do compose new screens from the primitives in `web/src/ui/` and the shell frame.
donts: Don't add a light theme, white panels, or large bright fills; the interface is used in the dark.
Don't drift toward a neon sci-fi HUD: no glowing cyan or purple, scanlines, or space-game chrome.
Don't bring in glossy consumer SaaS styling: no gradients, no big rounded cards with drop shadows, no marketing flourishes inside the app.
Don't use cool blue-gray darks; every neutral stays warm.
Don't put a shadow on anything that sits in the layout; shadows are only for floating layers.
Don't let colour carry a state alone.
Don't add a status surface, toolbar zone, or frame outside the fixed shell.
